title: CF Meet Developer Platform control plane v1
description: Section 50 control-plane resources: organizations (Platform Access tenants), human workspace members and invitations, projects (Platform Access applications), environments (Platform Access environments), service accounts (read through Platform Access delegation; never credentials), commercial plan / assignment / billing-account references, immutable activity events and effective entitlements. Identity, credentials and scopes stay Platform Access's. 1.2.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): credentials (metadata only; the secret once), credential policy and quota restrictions, scope registry and grants, production-access requests / status / decisions, usage summaries, facts, limits and warnings, support profiles, entitlement overrides and the usage ingestion / reconciliation contract. 1.4.0 (ADR 0062 / 0063, CF Meet Platform Build): partner users (EndUser, EndUserList, Create/UpdateEndUserRequest), user tokens (UserTokenGrants, IssueUserTokenRequest, UpsertUserTokenRequest, UserToken, UserWithToken, RevokeSessionsResult), allowed websites (AllowedOrigins, PutAllowedOriginsRequest), push credential metadata (PushCredential(List), CreatePushCredentialRequest; secrets are write-only and sealed), production capabilities END_USERS and PUSH, usage type MESSAGE_SENT. 1.5.0 (ADR 0064 / 0065, CF Meet Apps): App, AppManifest, PutAppRequest, AppStatus, AppClientSecret (once), AppGrant(List), PutAppTestAccountsRequest, OperatorApp, AppDecisionRequest, DirectoryApp(List) and the OAuth wire shapes (snake_case): OAuthTokenRequest, OAuthRevokeRequest, OAuthToken, OAuthError, OAuthUserinfo, OAuthMetadata.

Role.description: Part VI workspace role (Section 50 permission matrix).

id.description: The organization id IS the canonical Platform Access tenant id.

classification.description: Platform Access tenant classification (operator-controlled; GET of one organization only).

OrganizationList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

userId.description: Opaque CF Meet account id (human developer); not a Platform Access principal.

MemberList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

token.description: One-time acceptance token, returned ONLY in this response (stored as a digest; never readable again).

InvitationList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

id.description: The project id IS the canonical Platform Access application id.

ProjectList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

scopes.description: Platform Access application scope grants (Platform Access is the authority).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access environment id.

authorityStatus.description: Status reported by Platform Access (GET of one environment).

EnvironmentList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

kind.description: PRODUCTION environments are activated by the production-access workflow (Section 55).

ServiceAccountStatus.description: Platform Access service-account status. The Developer Platform suspends / resumes (ACTIVE ⇄ SUSPENDED); REVOKED is terminal and an operator decision. A non-ACTIVE service account's API credentials do not authenticate.

ServiceAccount.description: A Platform Access service account (machine identity) of one environment, read through the Developer Platform. Platform Access is its only store; API credentials (secrets) are never part of it (Section 54).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access service account id.

name.description: Stable key, unique within the environment.

ServiceAccountList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

name.description: Stable key: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter or digit; unique within the environment.

CreateServiceAccountRequest.description: Creates a service account in a SANDBOX / TEST environment (PRODUCTION is refused: production-access workflow). No credential is issued (Section 54).

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

ActivityList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

CommercialPlan.description: An immutable commercial plan version. No price exists in Part VI.

CommercialPlanList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

PlanAssignmentList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

BillingAccount.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

subject.description: Internal reads with serviceAccountId / credentialId: the caller's own (never higher) limits and levels; the top-level values stay the environment's.

Entitlements.description: Effective platform entitlements (Section 54 §10.4 precedence: organization plan, explicit operator override, stricter project plan, environment cap, service-account and credential restrictions; the most restrictive value wins and the limiting level is named). Internal reads also carry the versioned snapshot consuming services cache.

lastAuthenticatedAt.description: Section 15 (PLT-008): when the credential last authenticated successfully, as recorded by Platform Access (debounced: may lag real use by up to 5 minutes); null when never seen since last-use tracking began.

expiringSoon.description: Section 15 (PLT-008): true when the credential stops authenticating (expiry, or the end of its rotation overlap) within 14 days — rotate it now. Null only from an older identity authority.

Credential.description: Section 54: metadata of a Platform Access API credential. Never a secret or verifier.

secret.description: The raw credential, shown exactly once (never on an idempotent replay).

secretRedacted.description: Present on an idempotent replay instead of the secret.

IssuedCredential.description: Section 54: an issued or rotated credential; the secret is returned once only.

ProductionAccessRequest.description: Section 55 production-access request: SANDBOX_READY → PRODUCTION_REQUESTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED / REJECTED → LIVE / SUSPENDED.

UsageSummary.description: Section 55: environment-scoped daily usage rollups and period totals (billing-neutral quantities).

UsageFactView.description: One immutable usage fact: safe resource reference and public dimensions only (no provider ids, rates or content).

EnvironmentLimits.description: Section 55: effective limits, current usage and remaining allowance where meaningful, and limit warnings.

SupportProfile.description: Section 57 support / incident routing metadata: member references only, no ticket content, emails or phone numbers.

UsageFactSubmission.description: A producer's usage fact (cf_usage_facts wire format); the digest is the canonical payload digest.

OperatorOrganization.description: Section 15 (PLT-009): an organization as listed to operators (no member role; who created it and whether a rename still has to reach Platform Access).

OperatorActivityEvent.description: Section 15 (PLT-009): one operator command — an OPERATOR event of an organization's activity (scope ORGANIZATION) or a platform-level command such as a plan publication or a usage rebuild (scope PLATFORM, organizationId null).

id.description: The Platform Access principal id (kind EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL).

EndUser.description: ADR 0062: a partner user (a Platform Access principal of the credential's environment). DEACTIVATED: deleted (profile erased, id kept).

EndUserList.description: A page of partner users; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

externalId.description: The partner's opaque user id (printable ASCII, no spaces); never a phone number, tel: / sip: URI.

UpdateEndUserRequest.description: Profile changes (`null` clears) and suspension / reactivation; deletion is DELETE.

msg.description: Chat: needs `messages.read` / `messages.send` on the minting credential.

mtg.description: Meetings the user may join, with a role: needs `meetings.write`. The token's compact `{c, r}` form is accepted too.

UserTokenGrants.description: ADR 0062 user token grants; effective grants are re-intersected with the minting credential's CURRENT scopes on every verification.

externalId.description: The partner's opaque user id (printable ASCII, no spaces); never a phone number, tel: / sip: URI.

UpsertUserTokenRequest.description: Creates the user if new (idempotent on externalId), then mints a token.

token.description: The CF Meet user token, shown ONCE (`Authorization: Bearer cfut_…` on the device).

tokenRedacted.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the token is never returned again.

token.description: The CF Meet user token, shown ONCE (`Authorization: Bearer cfut_…` on the device).

tokensNotBefore.description: Tokens issued before this instant (and every device credential derived from them) no longer work.

AllowedOrigins.description: ADR 0062: an environment's allowed websites (exact origins).

PutAllowedOriginsRequest.description: The complete list (replaces it): exact `scheme://host[:port]`, lowercase host, no path, no wildcard, no explicit default port; https only, except http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 in SANDBOX / TEST.

PushCredential.description: ADR 0063: push credential METADATA. The secret (APNs .p8 key / FCM service-account JSON) is sealed to the Notification Service on receipt and never stored, logged or returned.

apnsHost.description: SANDBOX and TEST environments may only use SANDBOX.

p8.description: The APNs token signing key (.p8, PEM). Write-only.

serviceAccountJson.description: The Firebase service-account key JSON (type service_account; its project_id, when present, must equal projectId). Write-only.

CreatePushCredentialRequest.description: Uploads (replaces) the environment's credential of that provider (APNS with voip false / true, or FCM).

AppManifest.description: ADR 0064: an app manifest (normalized; every change is a new immutable version).

PutAppRequest.description: PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/app: the manifest (http://localhost redirect URIs only while DRAFT; at least one user or bot scope; event types from the install-routable families).

App.description: ADR 0064 / 0065: the app registered on a project (clientId = projectId = the Platform Access application id). The live version is what Platform Access serves: the published version, else the approved one, else the current draft.

OperatorApp.description: ADR 0065: the operator view of an app (the manifest under review and the audited review history).

AppClientSecret.description: ADR 0064: a new client secret, returned ONCE (an idempotent replay returns clientSecretRedacted instead).

AppGrant.description: ADR 0064: an installation of the app (never a CF Meet account id).

PutAppTestAccountsRequest.description: ADR 0064: the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, format checked only, at most 25).

AppDecisionRequest.description: ADR 0065: an operator app decision (reject / suspend: safe reason code).

DirectoryApp.description: ADR 0065: a PUBLISHED, PUBLIC app of the directory (its published manifest).

meetingSurface.description: Whether the app has an in-meeting surface.

OAuthTokenRequest.description: RFC 6749 token request (application/x-www-form-urlencoded). Client authentication: HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) or client_id + client_secret in the body (client_secret_post), never both. PKCE (code_verifier, S256) is mandatory for authorization_code.

OAuthRevokeRequest.description: RFC 7009 revocation request (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; same client authentication as the token endpoint).

OAuthToken.description: RFC 6749 token response (snake_case). bot_token only on the first authorization-code exchange of an ORGANIZATION install with bot scopes.

OAuthUserinfo.description: The signed-in user's profile for an app: sub is pairwise per app; email only with profile:email.
